basic_info.description: Tucked along a quiet, tree-lined street in San Francisco's historical Lower Haight district, 463 Waller Street is a gracious two-level Edwardian that blends timeless detail with modern comfort.  The main level is a showcase of classic charm.The living room welcomes you with coffered ceilings, wainscoting, and an original built-in hutch. A remodeled open kitchen with Caesarstone counters, custom banquette seating, and south-facing windows flows naturally into the dining area, where sunlight filters in throughout the day. Three bedrooms on this level, including a serene front room with leafy outlooks & a private en-suite primary, provide a restful retreat. Downstairs, an expansive family room and half bath create the perfect bonus space for work, play, or accommodating guests.  Extensively renovated in 2013, the home enjoys updated systemselectrical, plumbing, heating, windowsalong with new lighting, hardware & the convenience of in-unit laundry.  Part of a three-unit TIC, residents share a landscaped, south-facing garden with irrigation and new fencing. Ideally situated near Duboce Park, Hayes Valley, NOPA, and Fillmore Street, with N/J MUNI, the Wiggle, and freeway access close at hand, 463 Waller offers historic charm, thoughtful updates, and an unbeatable central location.
